newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver prices end lower.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver prices end lower.

text.p: ** Indian 24 carat gold on Friday ended 10 rupees lower at
4,585 rupees per 10 grammes on weak world market trends
** Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) closed 100
** Silver (.999) ends five rupees lower at 6,725 rupees per
kg on sluggish industrial buying during the day
Indian 24 carat gold prices on Friday ended 10 rupees lower at 4,585 rupees per 10 grammes after poor world trends triggered a fresh wave of late-afternoon selling from a steady start, dealers said.
Gold was up by five rupees per 10 grammes on Thursday.
"Sluggish physical demand and a drop in the premiums of the special import licence for gold also subdued market sentiment," one broker said.
"These premiums have fallen from 10.50/10.60 percent to 10.10/10.20 percent."
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) closed 100 rupees lower at 53,600 rupees against the previous close of 53,700 rupees.
Silver (.999) closed five rupees lower at 6,725 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,730 rupees amid sluggish industrial demand. Silver was down by 20 rupees per kg on Thursday.
